(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.calcium-svg').dataset;const lo=document.querySelector('[data-calcium-group=measured]').transform.baseVal.consolidate().matrix,hi=document.querySelector('[data-calcium-group=corrected]').transform.baseVal.consolidate().matrix;if(Math.abs(Number(d.calciumResult)-2.7)>1e-8||Number(d.calciumCorrection)!==.2||Math.abs(lo.e-hi.e)>1e-5||Math.abs(lo.f-hi.f)>1e-5||Math.abs(lo.e)<1||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='2,70')throw Error('Calcium motion sensitivity');return 'Only calcium: both stages translate equally; correction stays .20';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.calcium-svg').dataset;if(Math.abs(Number(d.calciumResult)-2.5)>1e-8||d.calciumMeasuredX!==window.base.calciumMeasuredX||document.querySelector('[data-calcium-group=measured]').getAttribute('transform')!==window.lower||document.querySelector('[data-calcium-group=corrected]').getAttribute('transform')===window.upper)throw Error('Albumin sensitivity');return 'Only albumin: lower carriage fixed, upper head gains .20';})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('#anatomy-albumin').closest('.input-wrap').querySelector('select').value!=='1'||document.querySelector('[data-calcium-group=corrected]').getAttribute('transform')!==window.upper)throw Error('Unit conversion changes pose');const r=document.querySelector('#anatomy-albumin').closest('.calcium-input').querySelector('[type=range]');if(r.min!=='.1'&&r.min!=='0.1'||r.max!=='10'||r.step!=='0.1')throw Error('Albumin unit slider');return '30 g/l converts to 3 g/dl in both forms without moving the mechanism';})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('#field-albumin').value!=='2'||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='2,50')throw Error('g/dl input');return '2 g/dl means 20 g/l, corrected calcium 2.50';})()
(()=>{if(document.querySelector('#field-albumin').value!=='2,1')throw Error('g/dl knob step');return 'Albumin knob keyboard advances .1 g/dl (1 g/l)';})()
(()=>{if(document.querySelector('#anatomy-calcium').value!=='2,2')throw Error('Main/lower calcium sync');return 'Main calcium input updates the lower form and moving stages';})()

(()=>{if(Math.abs(Number(document.querySelector('.calcium-svg').dataset.calciumResult)+1.1)>1e-8||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='−1,10'&&document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='-1,10')throw Error('Signed negative output lost');return 'Negative result stays signed and visible';})()

(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector('.calcium-svg').dataset.calciumResult)!==0||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='0,00')throw Error('Zero output hidden');return 'Exact zero result remains visible';})()
